name: AlertDialog
description: Props for the AlertDialog host component.

parts.name: AlertDialog
parts.description: Props for the AlertDialog host component.

props.name: center
props.description: Centers the icon, title, and description, and stretches the actions into an equal row.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: close
props.description: Whether the corner close button is shown.

props.name: closeOnOverlayClick
props.description: Whether an outside pointer press on the overlay dismisses the dialog.

props.name: danger
props.description:
Shows a caution icon when `type` is `default`, and styles the primary action as `danger`
when its variant is omitted.

props.name: dialogRender
props.description:
Renders the inner content of every dialog on this host that was not opened with
`AlertDialog.custom`. Receives the instance context and the resolved call options.

props.name: id
props.description:
Unique identifier for this host when multiple hosts are mounted.
A call without `host` goes to the last mounted host without an id. Pass `host` in the
call options to target one host. If duplicate ids are mounted, the last mounted host takes precedence.
Unmounting a host settles its open dialogs with reason `api`.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: subtle
props.description: Gives the footer a top border and muted background, like Card's `subtle` variant.

props.name: type
props.description: Status tone. `default` has no icon unless `danger` is set.
